summary: The iridescent shark is a catfish, despite its aquarium name. Introduced to Malaysia for aquaculture, it is different from the native Pangasius nasutus and is widely raised in freshwater systems.
nativeRange: The Mekong, Chao Phraya and Mae Klong river systems.

features: Catfish body with a deeply forked tail
Two pairs of barbels around the mouth

habitat.description: Large river channels and seasonal floodplain waters; farmed in freshwater ponds and cages.
habitat.diet: Omnivorous; eats algae, zooplankton, crustaceans and fish.

eating: Raised extensively for food; exported fillets are commonly sold as swai.
